subject: Renewal pricing and capacity increase — Southport.ai
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@southport.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal + capacity bump

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I attached a term sheet that reflects a 12-month renewal with a 25% uplift to your committed capacity (to support the new inference pipeline you mentioned). High-level summary:

- Current: 1.2M token-commit/month at $0.0045/token
- Proposed renewal: 1.5M token-commit/month (12 months)
- Price: $0.00425/token (3-month price hold, then reprice)
- One-time renewal credit: $50,000 applied across months 1–6

I know the team cares about predictability — we can protect you with a short price-hold while you ramp. If you need a longer hold or a different credit structure tied to usage, we can discuss.

Can we jump on a 30-min call Thursday to align on whether this counter works and where we need to move on terms (SLA, burst, data residency)? If yes, I’ll drop a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Southport_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@southport.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@southport.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + capacity bump

Thanks Michael —

Appreciate the draft. A few immediate asks from our side:

- Longer price-hold: three months feels short for our budget cycle. Can you hold pricing for 9–12 months?
- Commit uplift: we’re comfortable increasing capacity but prefer a phased ramp (50% increase month 1, then review usage).
- Credits: can the credit be front-loaded (months 1–3) rather than spread to month 6? That helps cash flow.

Attached is our Q1 usage export so you can see how the ramp looks on our side. Also, we need explicit language on burst capacity — we will need up to +40% burstability for product launches with predictable throttling behavior.

If you can update the term sheet with a 12-month price-hold and phased commit proposal, that would be most helpful.

Elena Morales
Head of Platform, Southport.ai
elena.morales@southport.ai | +1 212-555-9870

Attachments: Southport_usage_report_Q1.csv

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@southport.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + capacity bump

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 11:03 AM Elena Morales <elena.morales@southport.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Michael —
> 
> Appreciate the draft. A few immediate asks from our side:
> 
> - Longer price-hold: three months feels short for our budget cycle. Can you hold pricing for 9–12 months?
> - Commit uplift: we’re comfortable increasing capacity but prefer a phased ramp (50% increase month 1, then review usage).
> - Credits: can the credit be front-loaded (months 1–3) rather than spread to month 6? That helps cash flow.

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Internal thoughts below and a proposed compromise:

Proposed compromise (counter-offer):
- Price hold: 9 months at the proposed $0.00425/token (months 1–9). After month 9, standard tier pricing applies.
- Commit ramp: start at +50% commit in month 1 (1.8M tokens/month), automatic review at month 4 with a scheduled cadence to scale to full 25% uplift by month 6 if usage justifies it.
- Credits: $60,000 one-time credit front-loaded in months 1–3 (applied monthly based on invoice).
- Burst: guaranteed burst up to +35% with fair-use throttling and 30-minute smoothing window; higher burst negotiated as add-on.

I’ve attached an updated term sheet reflecting the above. Laura and Aditya, can you weigh in on margin/finance impact and whether we can approve a 9-month hold + $60k credit?

If that’s acceptable to Southport, we’ll prepare an exec summary and DocuSign packet for legal to review. Happy to take 30 minutes tomorrow to lock details.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Southport_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + capacity bump (finance note)

Michael / Laura —

Quick finance note on the proposed counter:

- $60k credit front-loaded reduces first-quarter recognized revenue materially (~~12% impact to expected renewal ARR for Q2 depending on invoicing timing). We can cover this if Southport signs a 12-month committed term and we take the ramp as structured.
- Nine-month price-hold is workable, but I’d like the credit to be structured as usage-tier credits to reduce downside if they underuse in months 1–3. Suggested: $40k unconditional + $20k contingent on hitting >=80% of the 1.8M commit in month 1 and month 2.
- Legal/payment: propose standard 30-day invoice terms and annual prepay option (5% discount) if they want to lock cash discount.

I’ll draft a short finance memo and send to legal for a narrow amendment to the MSAs; attaching a note with impacts. If everyone is aligned, I can sign off for final approval and we can push DocuSign.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Attachments: finance_pricing_note.docx

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@southport.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh@southport.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + capacity bump

Michael / Aditya —

Thanks — the compromise reads fair. A couple of final asks before we execute:

- We accept the 9-month price-hold at $0.00425/token.
- Credits: we prefer the unconditional $40k + $20k contingent structure you proposed. OK to proceed.
- Burst: +35% guaranteed sounds reasonable; please add a short note that burst billing only applies if sustained >15 minutes at >35% beyond fair-use within a 24-hour window.

Please send the updated term sheet + DocuSign and I’ll route to our legal and procurement for a final review. If we can get DocuSign today, we will try to return a signed copy by Friday.

Elena Morales
Head of Platform, Southport.ai

Forwarded-For-Records: Southport internal procurement (Rajesh)
